learned: 2026-10-17: Nanticoke (the 5Boro maker) has one /lab-results page of ~490 self-hosted PDFs for all its brands (5Boro, Alibi, oHHo, Ready 2 Roll, Back Home Farm, Milkweed, Gentlemen Smugglers, Nanti Nitro), grouped in sections; only some section headers say '(5Boro brand)'.
notes: The links source cannot filter by page section, so other brands' reports are kept out by `skip` on brand names and on vape/edible words (5Boro's catalog is flower, prerolls, blunts). Some house-brand flower may still slip through; matching is by strain against the 5Boro catalog.
Link text is 'Strain Lot #: LOT' (sometimes 'Strain #: LOT'); filenames are Strain_Size_Format_LOT.pdf.
